role: The checked exception JsonToNBT throws for a malformed tag string.
scope_reason: Its only throwers are JsonToNBT (the tag-string parser) and the command classes and chat GUI that call it; commands are unused in this game and the chat screen is never opened by the agent or play inputs.

members.name: NBTException
members.note: No native parser of the vanilla tag-string format exists; the native dev ops carry NBT as JSON in the tape, not as vanilla tag strings.

notes: Cited callers verified in oracle/src: GuiChat, CommandSummon, CommandSetBlock, CommandTestForBlock, CommandGive. None is reachable in the recorded game, so there is nothing to port and no evidence to cite.
